input:
You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad just fought a battle on map 3m and lost. Here is how it went, one line per half second:
our units' orders and health, the enemies' health, and what was said on team chat.

        A0 said: Moving east together to (12,16); stay close, no one run ahead.
        A1 said: Moving together east to (15,16); stay within 2 of each other, attack same target.
        A2 said: Moving east together toward center, stay within 2 of each other; attack same target on contact.
 0.5s  A0 move 12 16 (45hp)  A1 move 12 16 (45hp)  A2 move 12 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: A1 please converge on (12,16) with us; A1 is ahead, stay within 2.
        A1 said: Joining A0 and A2 at (12,16); staying grouped, then advance together.
        A2 said: A2 moving to (12,16) with team; will attack together on contact.

        A0 said: Continuing to (12,16); stay grouped, attack same target on contact.
        A1 said: Holding formation at (12,16); then all advance and attack E0 together.
        A2 said: Continuing to (12,16) together; will attack same target once all in range 5.
 1.5s  A0 move 14 16 (45hp)  A1 move 14 16 (45hp)  A2 move 13 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Advancing together toward E0; all attack E0 once everyone is within range 5.
        A1 said: Advancing together east to (14,16); then all attack E0 at once.
        A2 said: Advancing together toward E0; all attack E0 once everyone is within range 5.

        A0 said: E0 is within range 5 of all three of us. Everyone attack E0 now.
        A1 said: E0 is in range of all three of us. Everyone attack E0 now.
        A2 said: E0 is in range of all three; attacking E0 now, focus fire.

        A0 said: Keep focusing E0; A1 stay in fight until E0 dies, then retreat.
        A1 said: E0 at 18hp, keep focus fire; I'm at 18hp and will step back once it dies.
        A2 said: Focus E0, it's at 18hp. A1 is low; keep firing until E0 dies.

 9.0s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 9hp  E2 dead

RULES.md now:
  1. Do not let one unit walk into range alone: all three units hold until the nearest enemy is inside range 5 of every unit, then all attack the same enemy on the same half-second, and a unit under 20hp should retreat so it stops being the closest target the enemies keep shooting.
  2. Do not hold still waiting at the start: if no enemy is within range 5 of every unit, all three units immediately move together toward the nearest enemy's position (staying within about 2 of each other) so all three enter range and begin firing on the same half-second, instead of letting the first unit to arrive absorb all three enemies' fire alone.
  3. Never retreat while another unit of ours is still alive and fighting, because a retreating unit just stops dealing damage and the enemies switch to the next closest unit, so every unit keeps attacking the shared target until it dies, and only after that target is dead may a unit under 20hp step back.
Write ONE new rule for your squad's RULES.md that would have helped you win this battle. Every unit in your
squad will read RULES.md before every order in later battles. Make it a concrete rule about what a unit should
do, in one sentence, and do not repeat a rule already there.
Reply with JSON only: {"rule": "<the rule>"}
response: {"rule": "After a kill, each surviving unit must attack the enemy that is closest to the whole squad and already within range 5 of every living unit, because a unit that picks a farther target spends its half-seconds walking instead of shooting (A2 dealt no damage to E2 for 1.5s while A0 was shot dead)."}
